hero.title: Your README,
hero.subtitle: Code, anime, music, games and repositories in SVG cards that update themselves. One line of markdown and you're done.

how.title: From zero to a ready README in
how.subtitle: You configure it once. After that the card updates itself.

steps.title: Sign in and connect
steps.body: GitHub, Google or e-mail. Authorize the platforms you want to show — revocable at any time.

steps.title: Pick your sections
steps.body: Start from a template or build from scratch: each plugin ships several sections and you enable only what you care about.

steps.title: Tune the look
steps.body: Default or terminal style, color theme, half or full width — all with the real SVG right next to you.

steps.title: Paste one line
steps.body: Copy the markdown and paste it into your README. We host the SVG and refresh it on a cycle — or on demand.

plugins.title: Connect the platforms that define you
plugins.subtitle: Each plugin ships a set of ready-made sections. Enable as many as you want on the same card.

descriptions.github: Repositories, activity and your contribution calendar.
descriptions.lastfm: Recent tracks, top artists, albums and songs.
descriptions.myanimelist: Anime and manga stats, favorites and activity.
descriptions.steam: Recent games, most played and library hours.
descriptions.duolingo: Streak, XP and the languages you're learning.
descriptions.16personalities: Your personality type as a badge.
descriptions.github_repo: Banner, counters, star curve, languages and topics.

templates.title: No time to start from scratch
templates.subtitle: Ready-made combos of plugins, sections and theme. Pick one and tweak it later.

repos.title: Cards for your repositories too
repos.subtitle: In {mode} mode you pick a single visual — banner, counters, star curve or stack — and paste it into the project README. Each visual has its own size and detail options.

styles.title: The same content, any skin you like
styles.subtitle: Switching styles takes one click and loses nothing — sections and data stay exactly the same.
styles.soonBody: Styles are pluggable: the same content, another skin. Suggest the next one in the discussions.

features.title: Nothing in your repository but one line

items.title: No GitHub Action
items.body: No workflow, no YAML, no gist to configure. We host the SVG for you.

items.title: Updates itself
items.body: Automatic refresh on a cycle, plus a button to regenerate instantly whenever you want.

items.title: Preview before publishing
items.body: The editor shows the real SVG, at real size, while you tweak the options.

items.title: Your keys stay yours
items.body: OAuth where it exists, API key where it's needed — revocable at any time.

items.title: Repositories too
items.body: Banner, counters and star curve for a specific repo, not just your profile.

items.title: Open source
items.body: Generator, plugins and dashboard under Apache 2.0. Write a new plugin if yours is missing.
